meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed the operator preview guide against the actual owner UI, fallback contact link, logo precedence and separate Integration fields.

public-mcp.review_note: Reviewed the published contact projection reused by the mail shell. MCP schemas, transport, authorization and tool behavior are unchanged.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed payment completion and owner/customer mail boundaries. Body identity and help links change on new messages without modifying checkout, charge or invoice operations.

sales-channels.review_note: Confirmed the existing catalogue optimiser and filename handling remain the default. Only brand uploads retain the original raster type.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed the new-client upgrade and mail-preview sequence against current owner settings, public profile and SMTP configuration. Browser assertions use isolated fixture identities.
